Discuss how likely the predictions below are.  • Privacy will become a thing of the past. • By the early 2030s, we will be able to copy human consciousness to a computer. • Wireless Internet connection will be available anywhere on our planet. • All forms of transport will eventually become electric. • The effects of climate change will be irreversible. • Physical money (coins and notes) won't exist anymore. • Scientists will unlock the genetic secrets that could allow us to live for centuries, maybe forever.

message.content:
Privacy is unlikely to vanish completely because technology, law, and social resistance will keep some private domains, even as surveillance grows Privacy
Consciousness copying by the early 2030s is very unlikely because mapping subjective experience and replicating a full mind remains far beyond current neuroscience and computing Consciousness
Wireless coverage everywhere on Earth is increasingly plausible but truly universal planetwide access remains unlikely because terrain, cost, and infrastructure barriers will persist Wireless
Electric transport is highly likely for most vehicles and trains, less certain for long-distance aviation and shipping, yet overall electrification remains a strong long-term trend Electric
Climate effects becoming partially irreversible are likely because some ice sheets, ocean changes, and ecosystem losses may continue even after emissions peak Climate
Money disappearing as physical coins and notes is plausible in some rich economies but globally unlikely because cash serves crises, privacy, and less connected regions Money
Genetics may unlock major healthspan extensions, but centuries or immortality from genetic secrets remain speculative and far less likely in the near future Genetics
